jobs.title: Senior Systems Engineer - Network
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About 1X

We're building humanoid robots that work in home - doing the chores, handling the tasks, and giving people their time back. Simple, but it's not.

To do this right, we have to solve robotics, AI, manufacturing - at the same time, at scale, in a form factor that has to be safe enough to live with your family. If you're inspired by this, you'll thrive here. We've been at this since 2014 and we're at the point where the hard problems are behind us and the hard work is in front of us.

NEO is our flagship - a home robot designed to move, learn, and operate in the real world alongside real people. We're not demoing it - we're shipping it. We're excited to meet you, if this excites you.

If you've spent your career working on problems that matter and want to see them actually reach the world - this is that moment. We're scaling, we're hiring with intention, and we need people who want to build something that will genuinely change how humans spend their time - safely creating abundance for all.

About the Team

The Core team builds and owns the C++ infrastructure that NEO's entire stack runs on - sensor pipelines, motor control interfaces, networking, inter-process communication, and the foundational libraries that ship on every robot. Our code runs thousands of times per second on hardware moving through the real world, and its correctness and performance directly determine what every other team can build and ship. If you want to work on the systems layer that makes physical AI possible at scale, this is that team.

Your Charter

Own the design and execution of all networking systems on the core robot, working with our Cloud Infra and Apps teams to ensure we can scale robot operations end-to-end from fleet management to real-time VR teleop. This is critical-path work: as 1X scales from hundreds to tens of thousands of robots, the reliability, performance, and simplicity of networking is a critical piece of successful deployments. You will lead architecture decisions, build core components, and set technical standards for the team.

Key Outcomes:

  • Own the core networking systems for robots and design topologies that maximize QoS for peer-to-peer, peer-to-server, and one-to-many.

  • Design and implement load balancing strategies that maximize network utilization.

  • Manage seamless connectivity across multiple networks (eg wifi, 5G)

  • Build APIs & protocols that transmit multi-model data at scale, including high-bandwidth video

Key Competencies:

  • Deep understanding of network topology design for peer-to-peer, peer-to-server, and one-to-many multicast

  • Load balancing and resource management on both client and server

  • Experience architecting systems that support network transitions and degraded connectivity

  • Protocol design for high-bandwidth high-QoS multimodal payloads

  • End-to-end system thinking across hardware, embedded, network stack, and cloud including QoS design (e.g. traffic classes, scheduling, and budgeting).

  • Congestion control and bandwidth estimation for building an adaptive realtime stack.

Measurement discipline: realistic network emulation, tail-latency analysis, and cross-host timings (PTP/NTP).

Minimum Requirements:

  • 6+ years in network engineering, distributed systems, or related cloud infrastructure roles

  • Proven experience shipping network systems in production at large scale

  • Strong experience with network fundamentals including TCP/IP, UDP, and related video/audio protocols

  • Experience with wireless network (wifi/5G) in mobile or embedded systems

  • Shipping a realtime system over variable-bandwidth links.

  • Proficient in C++

Preferred Skills:

  • Experience in robotics, autonomous vehicles, drones, or other embedded realtime systems

  • Experience with video transport protocols such as WebRTC or MoQ.

  • Experience with edge computing or hybrid cloud/edge networking

  • Experience with multi-radio systems

What does a successful 1X Team Member look like

Team members at 1X who thrive here are builders. They move fast, own their work completely, and treat time like it's the one thing you can't get back - because it is. They say what they mean, finish what they start, and hold themselves to a standard before anyone has to ask. We push each other to be better, and we do it with honesty and respect.

Compensation Range

$190,000 - $230,000 + Equity

Benefits

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage

  • Generous paid time off, company holidays, and parental leave

  • 401(k) plan with company match (100% on the first 3% of contributions, 50% on the next 2%)

  • Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) and Health Savings Accounts (HSA) options

  • Commuter benefits (transit and parking)

  • Short-term and long-term disability, and life insurance

  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for mental health, financial, and personal support

  • Onsite snacks and catered lunches

Equal Opportunity Employer

1X is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, marital status, medical condition, genetic information, disability, military or veteran status, justice system impact, or any other characteristic protected under applicable federal, state, or local law.

About 1X

We're building humanoid robots that work in home - doing the chores, handling the tasks, and giving people their time back. Simple, but it's not.

To do this right, we have to solve robotics, AI, manufacturing - at the same time, at scale, in a form factor that has to be safe enough to live with your family. If you're inspired by this, you'll thrive here. We've been at this since 2014 and we're at the point where the hard problems are behind us and the hard work is in front of us.

NEO is our flagship - a home robot designed to move, learn, and operate in the real world alongside real people. We're not demoing it - we're shipping it. We're excited to meet you, if this excites you.

If you've spent your career working on problems that matter and want to see them actually reach the world - this is that moment. We're scaling, we're hiring with intention, and we need people who want to build something that will genuinely change how humans spend their time - safely creating abundance for all.

About the Team

The Cloud Infrastructure team owns the platform every other team at 1X builds on: our Kubernetes clusters, AWS accounts, CI systems, identity and access layer, and the GPU compute our AI, robotics, and fleet teams depend on every day. We're a small team with an outsized blast radius - there's no SRE org or ticket queue between us and the engineers we serve, so when a training run needs a thousand GPUs by Monday, a cluster goes down at 2am, or a robot in someone's home needs a secure path back to our cloud, it lands with us.

Your Charter

The mission of this role is to make 1X's cloud infrastructure reliable, secure, and self-service enough that every team building NEO can move as fast as the hardware allows. You'll own the reliability and scalability of our cloud infrastructure end-to-end, from architecture decisions through incident response, and build the automation and self-service tooling that lets the broader engineering team handle common requests safely on their own, without piling up technical debt. You'll also be a steady hand for day-to-day urgent requests and team support when the platform needs it most.

Key Outcomes

  • Design and maintain infrastructure-as-code systems that make provisioning and scaling reliable and easy.

  • Build self-service tooling that lets engineers safely handle common cloud requests without creating technical debt.

  • Drive incident response with clear communication and urgency, and lead post-incident remediations so we systematically improve.

  • Partner with the security team to strengthen cloud infrastructure security and reliability.

Key Competencies

  • Deep understanding of distributed systems, networking, and cloud architecture trade-offs.

  • Strong infrastructure-as-code mindset.

  • Pragmatic about balancing speed against long-term architecture.

  • Calm, clear communicator who brings urgency to incident response.

  • Bias toward automation and self-service tooling over manual toil.

  • Customer-focused attitude that shows up in how you support urgent requests from the team.

Minimum Requirements

  • Proven track record of 5+ years in a DevOps, SRE, or infrastructure engineering role.

  • Experience with hands-on production operation of a major cloud provider or large-scale on-prem infrastructure using modern tooling.

  • Experience with service-to-service communication, specifically identity and auth.

  • Demonstrated ability to write production code in Python and/or Go.

  • Experience with Terraform.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience in improving incident response processes.

  • Experience with AWS, Cloudflare, and/or GPU cloud providers.

  • Experience in infrastructure security.

  • Experience with chaos engineering and improving cloud reliability under adverse conditions.

  • Experience in improving CI as a platform.

What does a successful 1X Team Member look like

Team members at 1X who thrive here are builders. They move fast, own their work completely, and treat time like it's the one thing you can't get back - because it is. They say what they mean, finish what they start, and hold themselves to a standard before anyone has to ask. We push each other to be better, and we do it with honesty and respect.

Compensation Range

$190,000 - $230,000 + Equity

Benefits

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage

  • Generous paid time off, company holidays, and parental leave

  • 401(k) plan with company match (100% on the first 3% of contributions, 50% on the next 2%)

  • Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) and Health Savings Accounts (HSA) options

  • Commuter benefits (transit and parking)

  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for mental health, financial, and personal support

  • Onsite snacks and catered lunches

jobs.title: Material Handler - San Carlos
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About 1X

We’re building humanoid robots that work in home - doing the chores, handling the tasks, and giving people their time back. Simple, but it’s not.

To do this right, we have to solve robotics, AI, manufacturing - at the same time, at scale, in a form factor that has to be safe enough to live with your family. If you’re inspired by this, you’ll thrive here. We’ve been at this since 2014 and we’re at the point where the hard problems are behind us and the hard work is in front of us.

NEO is our flagship - a home robot designed to move, learn, and operate in the real world alongside real people. We’re not demoing it - we’re shipping it. We’re excited to meet you, if this excites you.

If you’ve spent your career working on problems that matter and want to see them actually reach the world - this is that moment. We’re scaling, we’re hiring with intention, and we need people who want to build something that will genuinely change how humans spend their time - safely creating abundance for all.

 

About the Team

The Materials & Logistics team is the heartbeat of our San Carlos operation — the people who keep components flowing, production lines stocked, and shipments moving on time. Without us, NEO doesn’t get built. Every robot that walks out of our facility starts with the work this team does, and we take that responsibility seriously.

 

Your Charter

As a Materials Handler, you are directly responsible for ensuring the physical flow of materials that keeps NEO production on schedule. Manufacturing and engineering depend on you to have the right parts in the right place at the right time — every shift, without exception. This role sits on the critical path between supply and build, and the precision of your work translates directly into our ability to ship robots that change how people live.

 

Key Outcomes

  • Maintain inventory accuracy at or above 99% through disciplined scanning, labeling, and system updates.

  • Keep production lines continuously supplied — zero stoppages caused by material delays on your shift.

  • Process inbound, outbound, and internal transfers with complete, accurate documentation, every time.

  • Own the safety and organization of your work area — every shift ends cleaner and safer than it started.

  • Respond to shifting production priorities quickly, escalating risks early so the team can adjust.

 

Key Competencies

  • Bias for action — you see what needs to be done and move on it without waiting to be asked.

  • Detail-obsessed — you treat inventory accuracy and documentation as non-negotiable, because downstream teams depend on it.

  • Calm in a fast-paced environment — priorities shift, equipment moves, and you stay focused and safe through it.

  • Team-first communication — you flag issues early, share context generously, and never let a teammate get blindsided.

  • Safety mindset — you understand that one shortcut can hurt someone, and you refuse to take it.

 

Minimum Requirements

  • Prior experience in warehouse, logistics, or materials handling.

  • Hands-on experience operating forklifts and pallet jacks — certification is ideal but not a deal breaker if you can pass training quickly.

  • Comfortable using scanners, labels, and shipping documentation in a daily workflow.

  • Able to perform physical work, including lifting and moving materials throughout a full shift.

  • Reliable and punctual — your team is counting on you to be there, on time, every shift.

 

Preferred Skills

  • Experience working in a manufacturing or production environment (electronics, automotive, or robotics a plus).

  • Familiarity with WMS or ERP systems (NetSuite, SAP, Oracle, or similar).

  • Current forklift certification.

  • Experience supporting a fast-scaling operation where processes are still being built.

 

What does a successful 1X Team Member look like

Team members at 1X who thrive here are builders. They move fast, own their work completely, and treat time like it’s the one thing you can’t get back — because it is. They say what they mean, finish what they start, and hold themselves to a standard before anyone has to ask. We push each other to be better, and we do it with honesty and respect.

 

Compensation Range

$25.00/hr – $32.00/hr + Equity

 

Shift Information

Day Shift: 6:00 AM – 2:30 PM

Swing Shift: 2:00 PM – 10:30 PM

Benefits

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage

  • Generous paid time off, company holidays, and parental leave

  • 401(k) plan with company match (100% on the first 3% of contributions, 50% on the next 2%)

  • Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) and Health Savings Accounts (HSA) options

  • Commuter benefits (transit and parking)

  • Short-term and long-term disability, and life insurance

  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for mental health, financial, and personal support

  • Onsite snacks and catered lunches

Equal Opportunity Employer

1X is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, marital status, medical condition, genetic information, disability, military or veteran status, justice system impact, or any other characteristic protected under applicable federal, state, or local law.
